notes: Dates are relative to the seed day ('today' or the CLI's --today override): 'today', '+3d', '-2d', '+2w', '+1m', '-40d'.
status is the manual work state: 'open' (default), 'in_progress', or 'waiting'. The section shown in the list is derived, never stored.
Expected section for each task at seed time is in 'expect', so tests can assert the board without re-deriving it by hand.
repeat.mode: 'schedule' (next due follows the calendar) or 'after_completion' (next due counts from the day it was completed).
repeat.startOffsetDays: the start date sits this many days before each due date, so the task stays in Upcoming until then.
When a repeat names byWeekday and the seeded due date isn't one of those days, the seeder moves the due date forward to the next day that is.

A waiting task's hideUntil is its own date (it may be after the due date). Only Open tasks have a 'start'; Waiting and In Progress tasks never do. 'waiting' = visible in the Waiting section (no hide-until date, or it or the due date has arrived). 'waiting_later' = tucked behind the section's 'Show N hidden until later' row.
flagged: true marks the single priority flag. It never changes a task's section or order.
afterPurge: whether a Trash task survives the next purge-trash ('kept' or 'removed'). Purge removes tasks whose deletion day is more than 30 days ago.
tags (top level) is the tag catalog; a task's tags are names from it (a name not listed there is created too). A task keeps its tags in the order listed, which is the order of its chips.
Seeds are checked in CI at a pinned --today (a Wednesday, plus a Saturday run), so weekday-dependent repeats like 'Stand-up notes' give stable results.
